description: This file defines the ConfigHelper class which provides methods to retrieve various configuration settings and directory paths for the OrangeHRM project. It includes methods for getting path configurations, plugin configurations, client configurations, and global settings, often resolving real paths and reading contents from files. The class manages internal configuration state and provides external access to configuration data.

classes.name: ConfigHelper
classes.description: A helper class for retrieving and managing configuration paths and settings within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getPathConfigs
methods.description: Returns an array of key configuration paths based on the project directory structure.

methods.name: getPluginConfigs
methods.description: Scans plugin directories to gather plugin names, paths, and configuration data.

methods.name: getPluginConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves plugin configuration details from a plugin directory if available.

methods.name: getClientConfigs
methods.description: Provides client-related configuration including directories and version info.

methods.name: getGlobalConfigs
methods.description: Provides global configuration flags such as internationalization and session timeout settings.

methods.name: getConfigs
methods.description: Aggregates all configuration segments into a single array for external access.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a specific configuration value by name, with optional default.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Merges new configuration parameters into the existing configuration array.
